about: The Portal lane's P5c-3c-i (to-dos/gc-mode/mockups/portal-p5.md, P5c-3c split in two, the lead 2026-10-10): the trade's half of the pay application, lifted to src/components/gc word for word (decision 9): the door, the closeout, the failed inspection, the window and the G702 and G703 (GcBuildingPayApp.tsx, as GcTradePortalPayApp.tsx on main), and the notary block. Placed whole by the lane, since lift-extract.cjs reads only .ts; the office's half is Building's own GcDrawPayApp.tsx. Its sends, pay_app and final_pay_app with the sign step on the app's conditional waiver paper, are P5c-3c-ii, held by WAIVER_SIGN_LIVE. GcSovSideBySide stays on the spike: only the office's view drew it, and its kernels wait on the Board's B6. Run: node to-dos/gc-mode/scripts/lift-same.cjs to-dos/gc-mode/scripts/portal-p5c-3c-i.lift.json
